body.p: This book contains links to the three other volumes of The Secret Doctrine in the Project Gutenberg collection. The references to volume I are to “The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 1 of 4”, Project Gutenberg e-book 54824, and are linked to it; likewise, the references to volume II are to “The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 2 of 4”, Project Gutenberg e-book 54488, and the references to volume III are to “The Secret Doctrine, Vol. 3 of 4”, Project Gutenberg e-book 56880. Although we verify the correctness of these links at the time of posting, these links may not work, for various reasons, for various people, at various times.
